== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Advocate]] headquarters serves as the central base for [[the Advocates]], an organization that originated as a band of vigilantes before evolving into a group with quasi-official [[Authority|authority]] within the [[Free Worlds]]. The facility is described as a floating, disc-shaped city featuring a prominent central tower. It is a highly secure location, utilizing defenses comparable to top-tier corporate vaults and containing specialized areas such as secure hangars and lockups. Historically, the headquarters has been a site of significant internal conflict regarding whether the organization should expand its influence across the galaxy or remain within its original mandate. The site has also suffered physical and emotional damage following a battle between [[Starhammer]] and a [[Zenith Device]], leaving the structure in poor condition despite the presence of [[Aether Technician|Aether Technicians]].}}
